svg.title: refresh: one successor per old token
svg.desc: Two nodes using the same old token cannot both publish successors. Account, API Key and credential-version checks can reject refresh. After success the client replaces the credential pair. Storage or network failures must not be reported as completed refresh.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: refresh: one successor per old token
